name: MonarchPayslipView
title: PayslipView
wrapsNative: VStack with MonarchSectionHeader groups, Grid and LazyVGrid of LabeledContent (.monarch), MonarchMoney and MonarchStatusBadge
summary: An on-screen payslip: issuer and title, employee and period details, pay lines grouped into earnings, deductions, reimbursements and employer contributions, the gross-to-net summary and year-to-date figures.
whenToUse: Showing one payslip or final settlement that payroll has already calculated, to the employee or to an administrator, with an optional Download PDF action.
whenNotToUse: For an invoice, use MonarchInvoiceView. For a list of pay runs or payslips, use rows with MonarchMoney and MonarchStatusBadge. The view never calculates pay; do not pass figures that payroll has not confirmed.
api: init(_ title: String, issuer: String? = nil, subtitle: String? = nil, status: MonarchStatusDefinition? = nil, details: [MonarchPayslipDetail] = [], lines: [MonarchPayslipLine], totals: MonarchPayslipTotals, yearToDate: [MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem] = [], yearToDateTitle: String? = nil, currencyCode: String, locale: Locale? = nil, hidesEmployerContributions: Bool = false, isDownloading: Bool = false, labels: MonarchPayslipViewLabels = MonarchPayslipViewLabels(), onDownload: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ title: String, issuer: String? = nil, subtitle: String? = nil, status: MonarchStatusDefinition? = nil, details: [MonarchPayslipDetail] = [], lines: [MonarchPayslipLine], totals: MonarchPayslipTotals, yearToDate: [MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem] = [], yearToDateTitle: String? = nil, currencyCode: String, locale: Locale? = nil, hidesEmployerContributions: Bool = false, isDownloading: Bool = false, labels: MonarchPayslipViewLabels = MonarchPayslipViewLabels(), onDownload: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil) where Actions == EmptyView
MonarchPayslipLine.init(_ id: String, name: String, kind: MonarchPayslipLineKind, amount: Decimal, note: String? = nil)
enum MonarchPayslipLineKind { case earning, deduction, reimbursement, employer }
MonarchPayslipTotals.init(gross: Decimal, deductions: Decimal, reimbursements: Decimal? = nil, net: Decimal)

MonarchPayslipViewLabels.init(earnings: String? = nil, deductions: String? = nil, reimbursements: String? = nil, employerContributions: String? = nil, grossEarnings: String? = nil, totalDeductions: String? = nil, netPay: String? = nil, yearToDate: String? = nil, noLines: String? = nil, download: String? = nil, downloading: String? = nil)

options.name: title
options.description: The heading, such as "Payslip" or "Final settlement"; also the payslip's accessibility name.

options.name: issuer
options.description: The paying organisation, above the title in the muted label style.

options.name: subtitle
options.description: A short line under the title, such as the period and payslip number.

options.name: status
options.description: A status badge beside the title, such as "Paid".

options.name: details
options.description: Employee and period facts: one column of inline label and value at compact width, three stacked columns at regular width.

options.name: lines
options.description: The calculated lines, grouped by kind in the order earnings, deductions, reimbursements, employer contributions.

options.name: totals
options.description: Gross, deductions, optional reimbursements and net pay from payroll, shown as given.

options.name: yearToDate
options.description: Year-to-date figures as tiles, as many per row as fit.

options.name: yearToDateTitle
options.description: Replaces the "Year to date" heading, for example "Year to date (from April)".

options.name: currencyCode
options.description: The ISO 4217 code of every amount, which are in major units.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts. Default: the environment's.

options.name: hidesEmployerContributions
options.description: Leaves out the employer contributions group, for an employee's copy where policy requires it.

options.name: isDownloading
options.description: The download is being prepared: the button shows a spinner and is read as "Preparing the PDF".

options.name: onDownload
options.description: Shows a secondary Download PDF button that runs this. The app makes and saves or shares the file.

options.name: actions
options.description: Extra header actions after Download PDF, such as Share.

states.name: default
states.description: Header, details, one headed group per kind with lines, the summary and year to date.

states.name: employer hidden
states.description: The employer contributions group is left out; the summary is unchanged because employer contributions are not part of net pay.

states.name: empty
states.description: No lines shows "No pay lines." in muted text; the summary still shows the totals given.

states.name: downloading
states.description: The Download PDF button shows a spinner and is read as "Preparing the PDF".

states.name: regular width
states.description: Details are in three columns; at compact width and at the accessibility sizes they are one column.

states.name: large text
states.description: Lines and summary rows put the amount under the name when they do not fit on one row; year-to-date tiles go to one per row.

appearance: The title uses the title type role in the default text colour; the issuer, notes and labels use the muted text colour; group headings are section headers; lines are separated by dividers in the subtle border colour. Net pay has a divider above it and a larger type role. Year-to-date tiles are filled with the subtle background colour in the container shape. Every colour is a theme role, so the payslip reads in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web PayslipView is an article with lists and description lists and accepts ReactNode slots and decimal or minor-unit amounts. On iOS amounts are Decimal in major units and the status is a MonarchStatusDefinition. The heading level option has no iOS equivalent; headings use the header trait. The web Download button is primary; here it is a secondary small button so it does not compete with the screen's main action. The parity map named List sections; the payslip is a plain stack instead, because a List cannot sit inside a screen's ScrollView with other content. Android ships the same MonarchPayslipView.
accessibility: The payslip is a container named by its title; the title has the header trait.
Each group heading is a MonarchSectionHeader with the header trait, so the rotor moves between Earnings, Deductions and the other groups.
Each line is one element read as its name, its note and its amount.
Each summary row, detail and year-to-date figure is read as its label and then its value.
Net pay is marked by a larger type role and a divider, not by colour.
While downloading, the button is read as "Preparing the PDF".
Text wraps at every Dynamic Type size; amounts move under their names when a row does not fit.
edgeCases: Deductions are passed and shown as positive amounts; the group heading says they are deductions.
Totals are never checked against the lines; a mismatch is shown as given.
Reimbursements of zero are left out of the summary.
A long line name wraps; its amount never wraps.
Download presentation (share sheet or file save) is the app's; the view only runs onDownload.

examples.title: Monthly payslip
examples.template:
ScrollView {
    MonarchPayslipView(
        {{title}},
        issuer: {{issuer}},
        subtitle: {{subtitle}},
        status: MonarchStatusDefinition({{status.label}}, tone: {{status.tone|tone}}, systemImage: "checkmark.circle"),
        details: [
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.0.label}}, value: {{details.0.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.1.label}}, value: {{details.1.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.2.label}}, value: {{details.2.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.3.label}}, value: {{details.3.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.4.label}}, value: {{details.4.value}}),
        MonarchPayslipDetail({{details.5.label}}, value: {{details.5.value}}),
        ],
        lines: [
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.0.name}}, name: {{lines.0.name}}, kind: {{lines.0.kind|case}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{lines.0.amount}})!, note: {{lines.0.note}}),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.1.name}}, name: {{lines.1.name}}, kind: {{lines.1.kind|case}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{lines.1.amount}})!),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.2.name}}, name: {{lines.2.name}}, kind: {{lines.2.kind|case}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{lines.2.amount}})!, note: {{lines.2.note}}),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.3.name}}, name: {{lines.3.name}}, kind: {{lines.3.kind|case}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{lines.3.amount}})!),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.4.name}}, name: {{lines.4.name}}, kind: {{lines.4.kind|case}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{lines.4.amount}})!),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.5.name}}, name: {{lines.5.name}}, kind: {{lines.5.kind|case}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{lines.5.amount}})!),
        MonarchPayslipLine({{lines.6.name}}, name: {{lines.6.name}}, kind: {{lines.6.kind|case}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{lines.6.amount}})!),
        ],
        totals: MonarchPayslipTotals(gross: Decimal(string: {{totals.gross}})!, deductions: Decimal(string: {{totals.deductions}})!, reimbursements: Decimal(string: {{totals.reimbursements}})!, net: Decimal(string: {{totals.net}})!),
        yearToDate: [
            MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.0.label}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{yearToDate.0.amount}})!),
            MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.1.label}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{yearToDate.1.amount}})!),
            MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.2.label}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{yearToDate.2.amount}})!),
            MonarchPayslipYearToDateItem({{yearToDate.3.label}}, amount: Decimal(string: {{yearToDate.3.amount}})!),
        ],
        yearToDateTitle: {{yearToDateTitle}},
        currencyCode: {{currency}},
        locale: Locale(identifier: {{locale}}),
        labels: MonarchPayslipViewLabels(download: {{download}}),
        onDownload: {}
    )
    .padding()
}

parityExceptions.reason: On a phone column the Download PDF button sits under the title block instead of at the top trailing edge, the details are two columns instead of three and the year-to-date tiles are two across instead of four; the sections, boxed lines, summary box, tones and copy are as on the web.
parityExceptions.convention: HIG: content reflows to the screen width
